exposure: Intrapartum magnesium sulfate exposure for eclampsia prophylaxis
preeclampsia with or without severe features
outcome: Composite of obstetric hemorrhage-related maternal morbidity outcomes (OBH-M)
cohort: 791 patients diagnosed with hypertensive disease of pregnancy (HDP) who delivered at the study institution between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2019
finding: Intrapartum magnesium sulfate exposure was associated with increased QBL and risk of OBH-M in vaginal deliveries but not in cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Intrapartum magnesium sulfate exposure was associated with increased quantitative blood loss and risk of obstetric hemorrhage-related maternal morbidity in vaginal deliveries, but not in cesarean deliveries.
